segments.an6.26:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā mahākaccāno bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an6.26:1.3: “Āvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.an6.26:1.7: Yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cha anussatiṭṭhānāni.
segments.an6.26:2.3: ‘itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
segments.an6.26:2.4: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:2.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:2.7: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:2.8: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:3.2: ‘svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo … pe … paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī’ti.
segments.an6.26:3.3: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:3.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:3.6: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:3.7: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:4.2: ‘suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’ti.
segments.an6.26:4.3: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:4.6: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:4.7: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
segments.an6.26:5.2: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako attano sīlaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:5.3: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:5.5: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:5.6: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, āvuso, ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati –
segments.an6.26:6.2: ‘lābhā vata me, suladdhaṃ vata me … pe … yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato’ti.
segments.an6.26:6.4: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:6.5: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:6.7: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:6.8: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:7.2: ‘santi devā cātumahārājikā, santi devā … pe … tatuttari.
segments.an6.26:7.3: Yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā; mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
segments.an6.26:7.4: Yathārūpena sīlena … pe … sutena … cāgena … paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā;
segments.an6.26:7.8: Yasmiṃ, āvuso, samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti;
segments.an6.26:7.9: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā.
segments.an6.26:7.11: Sa kho so, āvuso, ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena.
segments.an6.26:7.12: Idampi kho, āvuso, ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evamidhekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
segments.an6.26:8.2: Yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ cha anussatiṭṭhānānī”ti.

lines: Okāsādhigamoti ettha okāsā vuccanti cha anussatiṭṭhānāni, tesaṃ adhigamo.
Mahaggatenāti mahantabhāvaṃ gatena, mahantehi vā ariyasāvakehi gatena, paṭipannenāti attho.
Imasmimpi sutte cha anussatiṭṭhānāni missakāneva kathitānīti.
Chaṭṭhe sambādheti vā taṇhāsaṃkilesādīnaṃ sampīḷe saṅkare gharāvāse.
Visujjhanatthāyāti rāgādīhi malehi abhijjhāvisamalobhādīhi ca upakkiliṭṭhacittānaṃ visuddhatthāya.
Sā panāyaṃ cittassa visuddhi sijjhamānā yasmā sokādīnaṃ anupādāya saṃvattati, tasmā vuttaṃ “sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāyā”tiādi.
Tattha socanaṃ ñātibyasanādinimittaṃ cetaso santāpo antotāpo antonijjhānaṃ soko, ñātibyasanādinimittameva socikatā.
“Kahaṃ ekaputtakā”tiādinā (ma. ni.2.353-354; saṃ. ni.2.63) paridevanavasena lapanaṃ paridevo.
Dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāyāti kāyikadukkhassa ca cetasikadomanassassa cāti imesaṃ dvinnaṃ atthaṅgamāya, nirodhāyāti attho.
Ñāyati nicchayena kamati nibbānaṃ, taṃ vā ñāyati paṭivijjhati etenāti ñāyo, ariyamaggo.
Idha pana saha pubbabhāgena ariyamaggo gahitoti āha “sahavipassanakassa maggassa adhigamanatthāyā”ti.
